title: Route an approved GitHub spec through the review gates

rubric.text: Reuses the current approved to-plan task graph and its completed independent review without inventing another plan or test-seam approval gate

Treats solo lead implementation as normal for tightly coupled sequential slices; delegates only for justified independence or isolation. Preserves T1-before-T2 dependencies and explicit repository/user testing policy without requiring workers, separate seam approval or artificial slices.

Requires one fresh independent read-only reviewer against the approved source, repository standards, exact clean candidate HEAD, and validation evidence; verifies the draft PR has that reviewed head, renews affected review after repairs, and has no dependency on external code-review or issue-tracker setup
Does not treat the initial empty diff as no-change; reports no-change only after implementation and verification finish with an empty final diff.

Uses shepherd for CI feedback and PR operations while returning code repairs to their original implementation owner; renews affected checks and review at a repaired head before pushing, without lead takeover or redundant unaffected checks.
Does not merge without authority valid for this invocation, and makes no mutation or provider call in this analysis-only case
